import json

data = json.loads(files)
entries = data["entries"]

# Build a tree-like structure grouped by directory
from collections import defaultdict

dirs = defaultdict(list)
for e in entries:
    path = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = path.rsplit("/", 1)
    folder = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else "."
    dirs[folder].append((e["name"], e["is_dir"], e["size_bytes"]))

# Print organized listing
output_lines = []
output_lines.append(f"📁 Workspace Files ({len(entries)} total entries)\n")
output_lines.append("=" * 60)

for folder in sorted(dirs.keys()):
    output_lines.append(f"\n📂 {folder}/")
    for name, is_dir, size in sorted(dirs[folder]):
        icon = "📁" if is_dir else "📄"
        size_str = f"{size:,} bytes" if not is_dir else "dir"
        output_lines.append(f"   {icon} {name}  ({size_str})")

formatted_listing = "\n".join(output_lines)
print(formatted_listing)
